summary: Every server action under `app/(mainlayout)/admin/**` opens with the page's own gate — `requireAdminProduct()` then `requireOperator()` — so a build that does not claim the operator surface answers 404 to the action id too.
reader_impact: Nothing changes on either template this tree ships; `FLAG_PRODUCT_OPERATOR=0` now closes the write path as well as the twenty-three pages, so an action id scraped from an older build cannot be POSTed.
